title: Work & leadership.
subtitle: Internships, roles, and studio work that shaped the path so far.

entries.description: Led communications and member engagement for a 500+ attendee conference. Ran the "I Will Be Joining" campaign and supported the launch of a new chapter at UENR. Awarded a Certificate of Appreciation by Ing. Henry Antwi (FAusIMM).
Supported geotechnical investigation and laboratory testing routines under senior engineers, across site characterization, soil testing pipelines, and reporting practice.

Founded and run a working design studio serving organisational clients across Ghana, including AusIMM Tarkwa, GESS-KNUST, ICGC, and Fragilda. Output spans brand identity, print production, and large-volume automation (500+ programmatically generated certificates).
First professional exposure to construction materials workflows on active project sites, including quantity tracking, materials handling, and site operations alongside the technical team.
